description.narrative:
Background: Oxfam Novib has started up a Powering Up Activists and Movements Strategy and is beginning to design its first DomesticInfluencing Programme in the Netherlands. As a part of both of those processes, we have spotted that there is a need to deepen our organisations awareness of, knowledge of, and involvement in, local level organising in the Netherlands. The changing context and shift to right wing and closure of civic space is also calling us to action. Oxfam Novib has in the past years alsoinvested in The Feminist Influencing Basket of Resources as a means to power-up more feminist ways of organising and influencing for social change. Andwill be a critical tool for both the Powering Up Strategy and the Wijk Model.
The project enables us to support local organising and to add to what is already happening. We have created a small project group around the Wijk Model. The primary goal of the Wijk Model is be listening and in conversation at the local, neighbourhood level in multiple Wijks at one time over the course of 1 year (and potentially longer depending on how the process evolves). The idea is to better understand the critical issues for people living there, how they understand them, their ideas for doing something about them. And where there’s a possibility, to develop action plans for responding to the needs that emerge. In addition, Oxfam hopes to shape an organising strategy and a people’s manifesto which will be a core part of our work in the Netherlands on claiming civic space.
Objectives: - Collective Action through community organizing to address power imbalances, fostering a culture of resistance and resilience where all voices matter equally to achieve socialchange - Strengthening how we engage communities by moving beyond our existing networks and connecting and being in conversation with locally rooted groups. - Develop a more grounded understanding of different social realities - Develop in consultation a community/locally rooted plan of action : A People’s Manifesto
Deliverables - Convene community hall meetings or Wijk meetings to discuss issues that matter to the community - Develop plans of action for addressing the issues that communities raise - Support implementation of community action plan : A People’s Manifesto - Integrate elements of the Feminist Basket into existing organising processes atthe local neighborhood level. - Support Oxfam Novib to shape its local organising strategy - Explore possibility of the Wijk contributing towards ‘People’sManifesto’ process.
Expected Outcomes for ONL - Built a track record for ONL work on strengthening civic space, democracy and rule of law, that cuts across our change goals (Units). - Strengthened ONL collaboration with locally rooted organisers andcommunities. - Implemented a People's Manifesto campaign at wijk level - Tested and validated the activist + movements strategy. - Developed the ONL community organising model.

participating-org.narrative: The Afrikaanderwijk Cooperative is building a more just world, starting in the neighborhood. They explore and test new ways of living together, working together, and collectively caring for one another. The cooperative provides citizen engagement and services in the areas of catering, cleaning, transportation, textile production, management, knowledge, and culture. In their cultural program, they explore the new world with exhibitions, performances, shows, and public discussions. They try out this new world in the execution of their services. All work is carried out by residents of the Afrikaanderwijk neighborhood. It is a nonprofit social enterprise.The proceeds benefit the residents of the neighborhood. In this way, they explore innovative ways of organizing based on shared responsibility and ownership.
